title: cyperus cruentus subsp. amauropus
intro: Cyperus cruentus subsp. amauropus, commonly known as the red papyrus, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus cruentus subsp. amauropus include analgesic, antipyretic, and antiseptic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. Additionally, the plant has been found to possess antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities, making it a valuable resource for the development of new medicinal products.
